_about: Shops, scrubs, merchants (tools/rando/parity/shops.py; and data/ootr_match.json 'evidence'). Rules where the remake differs from OoT, whatever the settings: the HF grotto scrub sells only to a child (its Secret flow gives an adult talk only), the Market Bombchu Shop's keeper appears only after the Goron Ruby stage (Presence Get_StoneOfFire_IsCompleted_Exp), the Wasteland carpet salesman sells only as an adult (the child file's Npc_Hylia_044_Child has no sale). Scrubs: the 24 OoTR scrubs the remake doesn't have are removed (SFM, GC, DMC hammer, ZR, LH, GV and Colossus grottos; Dodongo's Cavern lobby and bomb-bag room; Ganon's Castle); the Dodongo's Cavern side-room scrub stands behind a breakable WallCrack (no bomb-flower route assumed), the Jabu-Jabu scrub at water level (diving or Iron Boots assumed for both ages); the remake's two dungeon scrubs without an OoT twin are new locations (Bottom of the Well room 1: the region behind the fake walls, the stricter of the two room-1 regions; Shadow Temple room 9: the huge-pit room, past its moving platforms and guillotines). Potion shops: both potion keepers refuse to sell Blue Fire until the player has had it once (DisplayShop Outofstock_SelectBottle_BlueFire: Event490 Shop_SelectItemName == Item_Bottle_BlueFire, Event108 IsGet.Item_Bottle_BlueFire, else Event492-496 the out-of-stock talk while Market_ or KakarikoVillage_Hylia_020_Shop_Talking), so the two vanilla Blue Fire slots (Market Potion Shop Item 2, Kak Potion Shop Item 5) need OoTR's 'Blue Fire' (scooped in the Ice Cavern or Ganon's Castle) before their Buy Blue Fire counts; with remake_split_potion_shops no other potion slot takes Buy Blue Fire.
